# Moonclerk

MoonClerk is a platform that enables businesses to accept recurring and one-time online payments.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/moonclerk/.

## Actions

- **List Customers**: List customers (plans) from moonclerk.
- **List Discounts**: Retrieve a list of all discounts applied to customers.
- **List Payment Forms**: Retrieve a list of all payment forms.
- **List Payments**: List payments.
- **List Subscriptions**: List subscriptions.
